forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
Week 40, October: 3 visits were completed. 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. So far, 27 zones have been surveyed, 9 declared free, 29 areas released and 13 cleared; mines were found in 9 areas. 577 suspected or confirmed areas remain open.

No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. The access feed shows 9 zones closed. No dossiers or reports were held, and no reports were queried. A new plan, P10, was approved this week.

The week 40 forecast for the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is already done, is 12 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 11 zones declared free this season.
